en.headline: Chiikawa Artiverse at K11 Musea runs through Sunday
en.dek: The character exhibition at K11 Musea and the Tsim Sha Tsui harbourfront, including an outdoor carousel installation, is scheduled to end on 6 September.
body: The Chiikawa Artiverse exhibition at K11 Musea in Tsim Sha Tsui is due to close on Sunday, 6 September, after a run that began on 1 August, according to the venue and the Hong Kong Tourism Board.

Creative brand AllRightsReserved staged the show with official licensor Spiralcute International. Indoor galleries occupy the Kunsthalle at the K11 Art and Cultural Centre on the sixth floor of K11 Musea at 18 Salisbury Road. An outdoor installation, described by the organisers as the first Chiikawa-themed carousel, stands on the ground-floor promenade facing the harbour.

The indoor exhibition is listed as open from 10am to 10pm, with last admission at 8.45pm. The outdoor carousel is listed from 11.30am to 10pm, with last admission at 9.45pm. A merchandise shop on the sixth floor is listed from 10.30am to 10pm.

Organisers divide the display into four sections covering original drawings, interactive music, installation works and the kinetic carousel. More than 130 reproductions of drawings and character sketches by illustrator Nagano are on show. The Tourism Board listed general admission at HK$170 or HK$200, with higher-priced packages that include a carousel seat. Tickets have been sold through Klook and Maoyan.

zh.headline: 吉伊卡哇藝術宇宙特展周日完結
zh.dek: K11 Musea及尖沙咀海濰的吉伊卡哇特展連戶外迴旋木馬裝置，據場地及旅發局資料將於9月6日結束。
body: 據K11 Musea及香港旅遊發展局資料，「CHIIKAWA ARTIVERSE」特展由8月1日舉行至今，將於9月6日星期日結束。
展覽由創意品牌AllRightsReserved與官方授權方Spiralcute International合作舉辦。室內展區設於尖沙咀梵士巴利道18號K11 Musea 6樓K11藝術文化中心Kunsthalle；戶外則在地下海濰長廊設置主辦單位所稱全球首座吉伊卡哇主題迴旋木馬裝置。
場地公布室內展區開放時間為上午10時至晚上10時，最遲入場晚上8時45分；戶外迴旋木馬為上午11時30分至晚上10時，最遲入場晚上9時45分；6樓紀念品店為上午10時30分至晚上10時。
主辦單位把展覽分為原畫、音樂互動、裝置藝術及機動藝術四個部分，展出插畫家Nagano逾130幅原畫及角色構思圖複製本。旅發局列出一般門票為170元或200元，另有包括迴旋木馬座位的套票。門票經Klook及貓眼發售。
